units.source_text: 黑69的强硬进攻，连名人也没有意料到。

en.t: Even the Master had not expected Black 69's forceful attack.

units.source_text: 这一应手，整整苦思了一小时四十六分钟，是这盘棋开始以来名人思考时间最长的一次。

en.t: For this response, he pondered in agony for a full hour and forty-six minutes, the longest time the Master had spent thinking since the game began.
